title: From a commit to a Quick Workout
flow: Refill the Queue from a Commit

steps.why: Decides whether a commit may still spend a generation today: the daily cap counts commit generations, retries included, since local midnight.
Screens each commit: a Co-Authored-By trailer naming an AI assistant marks it as AI-written, which decides whether it is drilled when only AI-written commits count.
Ends the flow: every refill outcome is appended to the log, and reading it back must survive a line cut short by a crash.
